I see the lazy chunk handling. When `is_lazy` is true, it reads the block from disk. But in the fuzz target, the frame is in-memory (`frame->cframe != NULL`), so `frame->urlpath` would be NULL. Let me check - in `frame_get_lazychunk`, when `frame->cframe != NULL`, the else branch is taken and `*chunk = frame->cframe + header_len + offset`. The chunk is NOT marked as lazy in this case (the `*blosc2_flags |= 0x08U` only happens in the `frame->cframe == NULL` branch).

So `is_lazy` would be false for in-memory frames. Hmm.
